name: Jollof Rice
alt: Orange-red jollof rice in a serving container
description: Rice cooked in a seasoned tomato and pepper sauce, giving it its familiar orange-red color.
serving: Often served with chicken, fried plantain, or moi moi.

name: Egusi Soup
alt: Egusi soup with pounded yam and assorted meat
description: A thick soup made with ground melon seeds, leafy vegetables, and meat or fish.
serving: Often eaten with eba or pounded yam.

name: Moi Moi
alt: Moi moi served with a red stew
description: A soft, steamed bean pudding made from peeled beans, peppers, and onions.
serving: Enjoyed on its own or alongside rice or pap.

name: Nigerian Fried Rice
alt: Fried rice with vegetables and chicken
description: Seasoned rice mixed with vegetables such as carrots, green peas, and sweet corn.
serving: Commonly served with chicken and salad.

name: Ofada Rice
alt: Ofada rice and pepper stew served on a leaf
description: A Nigerian rice variety with a distinctive aroma, commonly served with a pepper stew.
serving: Sometimes presented on a leaf with stew on top.

name: Ogbono Soup
alt: A bowl of ogbono soup with assorted meat
description: A rich, stretchy soup thickened with ground ogbono seeds and cooked with meat or fish.
serving: Usually paired with a swallow such as eba.

name: Efo Riro
alt: Efo riro with leafy vegetables and red pepper sauce
description: A leafy vegetable stew cooked with peppers, palm oil, and meat or fish.
serving: Often served with pounded yam, eba, or rice.

name: Okra Soup
alt: Chopped okra soup lifted with a serving spoon
description: A soup made with chopped okra, known for its slightly stretchy texture.
serving: Enjoyed with a swallow and meat or fish.

name: Afang Soup
alt: A bowl of afang soup with leafy vegetables and meat
description: A vegetable soup made with afang leaves and waterleaf, often including meat and seafood.
serving: Commonly eaten with eba or another swallow.

name: Akara
alt: Golden akara bean fritters on a plate
description: Golden bean fritters made from ground peeled beans, peppers, and onions.
serving: A familiar breakfast pairing is akara with pap.

name: Puff Puff
alt: Round, golden puff puff on a white plate
description: Small, round pieces of yeast dough fried until golden, with a soft center.
serving: Enjoyed as a snack or as part of small chops.

name: Suya
alt: Seasoned suya skewers cooking over a grill
description: Grilled meat coated with a spicy seasoning, often cooked on skewers.
serving: Commonly served with sliced onions and pepper.

name: Dodo
alt: A plate of golden fried plantain slices
description: Slices of ripe plantain fried until golden, with a naturally sweet taste.
serving: Often served beside rice or beans.

name: Boli
alt: Roasted plantain beside groundnuts at a food stall
description: Roasted plantain, also called bole, with a lightly charred outside and soft center.
serving: Enjoyed with groundnuts or pepper sauce and fish.

name: Eba
alt: A serving of eba beside fish banga soup
description: A firm, smooth swallow made by stirring garri into hot water.
serving: Served with soups such as egusi, okra, or banga.
